          <h2>Customer Details</h2>
          <div class="grid">
            <div><label>Name <span>*</span></label><input id="intake-name" autocomplete="name"></div>
            <div><label>Phone <span>*</span></label><input id="intake-phone" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel"></div>
            <div><label>Email</label><input id="intake-email" type="email" autocomplete="email"></div>
            <div><label>Preferred Contact</label><select id="intake-contact">
              <option value="PHONE">Phone Call</option>
              <option value="WHATSAPP">WhatsApp</option>
              <option value="EMAIL">Email</option>
            </select></div>
            <div class="full"><label>Address</label><textarea id="intake-address" placeholder="Address or area"></textarea></div>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section class="card">
          <h2>Job Details</h2>
          <div class="grid">
            <div><label>Item / Device Type</label><input id="intake-item-type" placeholder="Book, frame, laptop, printer"></div>
            <div><label>Item / Device Name</label><input id="intake-item-name" placeholder="Project file, wedding frame, HP laptop"></div>
            ${computerFields}
            <div><label>Requested Delivery</label><input id="intake-delivery" type="datetime-local"></div>
            <div class="full"><label>Short Summary <span>*</span></label>
              <input id="intake-summary" placeholder="What should Tarangini do?"></div>
            <div class="full"><label>Full Instructions</label>
              <textarea id="intake-details" placeholder="Dimensions, color, fault, accessories, printing notes, urgency, special instructions"></textarea></div>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section class="card">
          <h2>Files / Proof</h2>
          <p class="muted">Preview or delete selected files before submitting. PDF files are analyzed before staff review.</p>
          <label>Select files</label>
          <input id="intake-files" type="file" multiple accept=".pdf,image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp">
          <div id="intake-file-preview" class="muted" style="margin-top:10px">No files selected yet.</div>
        </section>
        <section class="card">
          <h2>PDF Analyzer</h2>
          <p class="muted">PDF files are analyzed for page count, page size and best-effort colour content before submit.</p>
          <div id="intake-pdf-analysis" class="muted">No PDF selected yet.</div>
        </section>
        <section class="card">
          <h2>Consent</h2>
          <label><input id="intake-consent" type="checkbox" style="width:auto;margin-right:8px">I confirm the details and files are correct for Tarangini staff review.</label>
          <div class="actions">
            <button type="button" class="secondary" onclick="resetIntakeForm()">Clear Form</button>
            <button id="intake-submit-button" type="button" onclick="submitIntake()">Submit Request</button>
          </div>
          <p id="intake-status" class="muted" style="margin-top:10px"></p>
        </section>` : ''}`;
      const viewBody = portalView === 'track'
        ? trackingPanel
        : portalView === 'service'
          ? serviceForm
          : `<section class="hero">
              <small>Tarangini Customer Portal</small>
              <h1>Track your order or start a new job request</h1>
              <p class="muted">A cleaner portal for service selection, file upload, PDF checking and live order status.</p>
              <div class="facts">
                <div><span>Company</span><strong>${esc(formConfig.org.name)}</strong></div>
                <div><span>Start</span><strong>Select Service</strong></div>
                <div><span>Track</span><strong>Order ID + Phone</strong></div>
              </div>
              <div class="landing-actions">
                <button type="button" class="warm" onclick="openTrackingPage()">Track Existing Order</button>
                <button type="button" onclick="openServicePage()">Create New Request</button>
              </div>
            </section>
            ${servicePicker}`;
      app.innerHTML = `
        ${message ? infoMessage(message) : ''}
        ${tabs}
        <div class="view-shell">${viewBody}</div>`;
      if (portalView === 'service') refreshPortalServiceOptions();
      if (showDetails) {
        bindFilePreview();
        renderSelectedFiles();
      }
    }

    function bindFilePreview() {
      const input = document.getElementById('intake-files');
      if (!input || input.dataset.bound === '1') return;
      input.dataset.bound = '1';
      input.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const nextFiles = [...(input.files || [])].map((file, index) => ({
          id: crypto?.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : `file-${Date.now()}-${index}`,
          key: fileKey(file, intakeSelectedFiles.length + index),
          file,
          previewUrl: ''
        }));
        intakeSelectedFiles.push(...nextFiles);
        input.value = '';
        renderSelectedFiles();
      });
    }

    async function renderSelectedFiles() {
      const target = document.getElementById('intake-file-preview');
      const analysisTarget = document.getElementById('intake-pdf-analysis');
      if (!target) return;
      if (!intakeSelectedFiles.length) {
        target.textContent = 'No files selected yet.';
        if (analysisTarget) analysisTarget.textContent = 'No PDF selected yet.';
        return;
      }
      const details = [];
      const pdfCards = [];
      if (analysisTarget) analysisTarget.innerHTML = '<span class="tag">Analyzing selected files...</span>';
      for (const item of intakeSelectedFiles) {
        const file = item.file;
        let extra = '';
        if ((file.type || '').startsWith('image/') && !item.dimensions) {
          try { item.dimensions = await imageDimensions(file); } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (item.dimensions) extra += ` | ${item.dimensions.width} x ${item.dimensions.height}`;
        if (file.type === 'application/pdf' || /\.pdf$/i.test(file.name || '')) {
          extra += ' | PDF Analyzer active';
          if (!item.analysis && !item.analysisError) {
            try { item.analysis = await analyzeSelectedIntakePdf(file); }
            catch (error) { item.analysisError = error.message; }
          }
          pdfCards.push(item.analysis
            ? renderIntakePdfAnalyzerCard(item.key, file, item.analysis)
            : `<div class="card" style="margin-top:12px">
                <h3 style="margin-bottom:8px">${esc(file.name)}</h3>
                <p class="message error">${esc(item.analysisError || 'PDF analysis failed')}</p>
              </div>`);
        }
        details.push(`<div class="file-row">
          <strong>${esc(file.name)}</strong><br>
          <small>${esc(file.type || 'application/octet-stream')} | ${esc(formatBytes(file.size))}${esc(extra)}</small>
          <div class="small-actions">
            <button type="button" class="secondary" onclick="previewSelectedIntakeFile('${item.id}')">Preview</button>
            <button type="button" class="secondary" onclick="removeSelectedIntakeFile('${item.id}')">Delete File</button>
          </div>
        </div>`);
      }
      target.innerHTML = details.join('');
      if (analysisTarget) {
        analysisTarget.innerHTML = pdfCards.length ? pdfCards.join('') : 'No PDF selected yet.';
      }
    }

    function removeSelectedIntakeFile(id) {
      const file = intakeSelectedFiles.find(item => item.id === id);
      if (file?.previewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(file.previewUrl);
      intakeSelectedFiles = intakeSelectedFiles.filter(item => item.id !== id);
      renderSelectedFiles();
    }

    function previewSelectedIntakeFile(id) {
      const item = intakeSelectedFiles.find(file => file.id === id);
      if (!item) return;
      item.previewUrl = item.previewUrl || URL.createObjectURL(item.file);
      window.open(item.previewUrl, '_blank', 'noopener');
    }

    function imageDimensions(file) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        const image = new Image();
        image.onload = () => {
          resolve({ width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight });
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        };
        image.onerror = () => {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          reject(new Error('Unable to inspect image'));
        };
        image.src = url;
      });
    }

    function fileToBase64(file) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result || '').split(',')[1] || '');
        reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Unable to read ${file.name}`));
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      });
    }

    async function analyzeSelectedIntakePdf(file) {
      const contentBase64 = await fileToBase64(file);
      const response = await fetch('/api/job-intake/analyze-file', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          file_name: file.name,
          mime_type: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
          content_base64: contentBase64
        })
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || 'PDF analysis failed');
      return result.analysis || {};
    }

    function toggleIntakePdfPrintRequest(key) {
      const enabled = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-print-${key}`)?.checked;
      const colorInput = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-color-${key}`);
      if (colorInput) colorInput.disabled = !enabled;
      syncIntakePdfCounts(key);
    }

    function syncIntakePdfCounts(key) {
      const enabled = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-print-${key}`)?.checked;
      const totalInput = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-total-${key}`);
      const colorInput = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-color-${key}`);
      const bwInput = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-bw-${key}`);
      if (!totalInput || !colorInput || !bwInput) return;
      let total = Math.max(1, Number(totalInput.value || 1));
      let color = Math.max(0, Number(colorInput.value || 0));
      if (!enabled) {
        color = 0;
        colorInput.value = '0';
        bwInput.value = String(total);
        return;
      }
      if (color > total) {
        color = total;
        colorInput.value = String(color);
      }
      bwInput.value = String(Math.max(0, total - color));
    }

    function intakePdfPrintRequestFor(item) {
      const file = item.file;
      if (!(file.type === 'application/pdf' || /\.pdf$/i.test(file.name || ''))) return null;
      const key = item.key;
      const totalInput = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-total-${key}`);
      const colorInput = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-color-${key}`);
      const bwInput = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-bw-${key}`);
      const confirmInput = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-confirm-${key}`);
      const printInput = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-print-${key}`);
      const notesInput = document.getElementById(`intake-pdf-notes-${key}`);
      if (!totalInput || !colorInput || !bwInput || !confirmInput || !printInput) return null;
      return {
        colour_print_active: Boolean(printInput.checked),
        customer_confirmed_total_pages: Number(totalInput.value || 0),
        customer_confirmed_color_pages: Number(colorInput.value || 0),
        customer_confirmed_bw_pages: Number(bwInput.value || 0),
        customer_page_confirmation: Boolean(confirmInput.checked),
        confirmation_notes: notesInput?.value?.trim() || ''
      };
    }

    async function attachmentPayloads() {
      return Promise.all(intakeSelectedFiles.map(async item => ({
        file_name: item.file.name,
        mime_type: item.file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
        content_base64: await fileToBase64(item.file),
        customer_pdf_print_request: intakePdfPrintRequestFor(item)
      })));
    }

    function valueOf(id, fallback = '') {
      return document.getElementById(id)?.value?.trim?.() ?? fallback;
    }

    function showValidationError(message, fieldId) {
      const status = document.getElementById('intake-status');
      if (status) status.textContent = message;
      alert(message);
      const field = fieldId ? document.getElementById(fieldId) : null;
      if (field?.focus) {
        field.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        field.focus();
      }
    }

    function resetIntakeForm() {
      intakeSelectedFiles.forEach(item => {
        if (item.previewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(item.previewUrl);
      });
      intakeSelectedFiles = [];
      selectedServiceId = '';
      portalDetailsVisible = false;
      nextClientRequestId();
      renderForm('Form cleared. Select a service to start again.');
    }

    async function submitIntake() {
      if (intakeSubmitInProgress) return;
      const status = document.getElementById('intake-status');
      const submitButton = document.getElementById('intake-submit-button');
      const submittedPhone = valueOf('intake-phone');
      const consentAccepted = Boolean(document.getElementById('intake-consent')?.checked);
      const quantityField = document.getElementById('intake-quantity');
      const payload = {
        org_id: orgId,
        client_request_id: clientRequestId,
        source_channel: 'QR',
        customer_name: valueOf('intake-name'),
        customer_phone: submittedPhone,
        customer_email: valueOf('intake-email'),
        customer_address: valueOf('intake-address'),
        preferred_contact: document.getElementById('intake-contact')?.value || 'PHONE',
        service_id: Number(selectedServiceId || document.getElementById('intake-service')?.value || 0) || null,
        item_type: valueOf('intake-item-type'),
        item_name: valueOf('intake-item-name'),
        device_brand: valueOf('intake-device-brand'),
        device_model: valueOf('intake-device-model'),
        device_serial: valueOf('intake-device-serial'),
        quantity: quantityField ? Number(quantityField.value || 1) : 1,
        requested_delivery_at: valueOf('intake-delivery'),
        issue_summary: valueOf('intake-summary'),
        issue_details: valueOf('intake-details'),
        consent_status: consentAccepted,
        consent_text: consentAccepted
          ? 'Customer confirmed QR intake details.'
          : '',
        attachments: []
      };
      if (!payload.service_id) {
        showValidationError('Select an exact service before submitting.', 'intake-service');
        return;
      }
      if (!payload.customer_name) {
        showValidationError('Enter customer name before submitting.', 'intake-name');
        return;
      }
      if (!payload.customer_phone) {
        showValidationError('Enter customer phone number before submitting.', 'intake-phone');
        return;
      }
      if (!payload.issue_summary) {
        showValidationError('Enter a short summary of the job before submitting.', 'intake-summary');
        return;
      }
      if (!consentAccepted) {
        showValidationError('Please confirm the details and files before submitting.', 'intake-consent');
        return;
      }
      intakeSubmitInProgress = true;
      if (submitButton) {
        submitButton.disabled = true;
        submitButton.textContent = 'Submitting...';
      }
      status.textContent = 'Preparing files and submitting request...';
      try {
        payload.attachments = await attachmentPayloads();
        const response = await fetch('/api/job-intake/submit', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || 'Unable to submit request');
        app.innerHTML = `
          ${infoMessage(result.duplicate
            ? `This request was already submitted. Order ID: ${result.order_id || result.request_number}.`
            : `Request submitted successfully. Your Order ID is ${result.order_id || result.request_number}.`)}
          <section class="hero">
            <small>Tarangini Customer Portal</small>
            <h1>Your Unique Order ID: ${esc(result.order_id || result.request_number)}</h1>
            <p class="muted">Keep this Order ID safe. If you are on the same network, you can use it with your phone number to check the order status anytime.</p>
            <div class="facts">
              <div><span>Request Status</span><strong>${esc(result.status)}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Files received</span><strong>${esc(result.attachment_count)}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Billing Link</span><strong>${result.billing_party_linked ? `Customer #${esc(result.party_id)}` : 'Pending'}</strong></div>
            </div>
          </section>
          <section class="card">
            <h2>Check This Order Status</h2>
            <p class="muted">Use your Order ID and phone number while connected to the same network.</p>
            <div class="grid">
              <div><label>Order ID</label><input id="lookup-order-id" value="${esc(result.order_id || result.request_number)}"></div>
              <div><label>Phone Number</label><input id="lookup-phone" value="${esc(submittedPhone)}"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="actions">
              <button type="button" class="secondary" onclick="resetIntakeForm()">Submit Another Request</button>
              <button type="button" onclick="checkExistingOrderStatus()">Check Status Now</button>
            </div>
            <div id="lookup-result" style="margin-top:12px"></div>
          </section>
          <section class="card">
            <h2>What happens next?</h2>
            <p class="muted">Staff reviews the request, checks file quality, links your customer record in Billing, and converts the request into a production job with a tracked job token.</p>
            <p class="muted">After conversion, the same Order ID will show the linked production job status and the accepted quotation too.</p>
          </section>`;
          localStorage.removeItem(`tarangini-intake-${orgId}`);
          nextClientRequestId();
      } catch (error) {
        status.textContent = error.message;
      } finally {
        intakeSubmitInProgress = false;
        const currentSubmitButton = document.getElementById('intake-submit-button');
        if (currentSubmitButton) {
          currentSubmitButton.disabled = false;
          currentSubmitButton.textContent = 'Submit Request';
        }
      }
    }

    async function checkExistingOrderStatus() {
      const target = document.getElementById('lookup-result');
      const orderId = document.getElementById('lookup-order-id')?.value.trim() || '';
      const phone = document.getElementById('lookup-phone')?.value.trim() || '';
      if (!target) return;
      if (!orderId || !phone) {
        target.innerHTML = infoMessage('Enter your Order ID and phone number to check status.', true);
        return;
      }
      target.innerHTML = '<p class="muted">Checking order status...</p>';
      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `/api/job-intake/status?org_id=${encodeURIComponent(orgId)}&order_id=${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}&phone=${encodeURIComponent(phone)}`
        );
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || 'Unable to load order status');
        target.innerHTML = statusCard(result);
      } catch (error) {
        target.innerHTML = infoMessage(error.message, true);
      }
    }

    nextClientRequestId();
    loadConfig();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    const app = document.getElementById('app');
    const token = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('token') || '';
    let currentJob = null;
    const esc = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, char =>
      ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[char]));
    const label = value => String(value || '').replaceAll('_',' ').toLowerCase()
      .replace(/\b\w/g, char => char.toUpperCase());
    const money = paise => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
      style:'currency', currency:'INR'
    }).format(Number(paise || 0) / 100);
    const date = value => value ? new Date(value).toLocaleString('en-IN') : '-';
    const formatBytes = value => {
      const bytes = Number(value || 0);
      if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
      if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
      return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`;
    };
    const pageSizeSummary = metadata => metadata?.page_size_summary || '';
    const printRequest = metadata => metadata?.customer_print_request || null;

    function pdfAnalysisPanel(attachment) {
      const metadata = attachment.metadata || {};
      const request = printRequest(metadata);
      if (attachment.mime_type !== 'application/pdf') return '';
      return `<div class="tag-row">
        ${attachment.pdf_page_count ? `<span class="tag">Pages ${attachment.pdf_page_count}</span>` : ''}
        ${pageSizeSummary(metadata) ? `<span class="tag">${esc(pageSizeSummary(metadata))}</span>` : ''}
        ${metadata.uniform_page_size ? `<span class="tag">Uniform ${esc(metadata.uniform_page_size)}</span>` : ''}
        ${metadata.has_mixed_page_sizes ? '<span class="tag">Mixed page sizes</span>' : ''}
        ${metadata.portrait_pages ? `<span class="tag">Portrait ${metadata.portrait_pages}</span>` : ''}
        ${metadata.landscape_pages ? `<span class="tag">Landscape ${metadata.landscape_pages}</span>` : ''}
        ${request?.colour_print_active ? '<span class="tag">Colour print active</span>' : ''}
        ${request?.customer_confirmed_total_pages ? `<span class="tag">Confirmed total ${request.customer_confirmed_total_pages}</span>` : ''}
        ${request?.colour_print_active ? `<span class="tag">Colour ${request.customer_confirmed_color_pages || 0}</span>` : ''}
        ${request?.customer_confirmed_bw_pages ? `<span class="tag">B/W ${request.customer_confirmed_bw_pages}</span>` : ''}
        ${request?.customer_page_confirmation ? '<span class="tag">Customer confirmed</span>' : ''}
      </div>`;
    }

    function renderAttachmentPreview(attachment) {
      if (!attachment.content_available) {
        return `<p class="muted">Preview expired. File name and analysis details are retained for this order.</p>`;
      }
      if (String(attachment.mime_type || '').startsWith('image/')) {
        return `<img class="attachment-preview" src="/api/job-portal/${encodeURIComponent(token)}/attachments/${attachment.id}/content" alt="${esc(attachment.file_name)}">`;
      }
      if (attachment.mime_type === 'application/pdf') {
        return '<p class="muted">PDF analyzer checked page count and page sizes. Open the file to review the original document.</p>';
      }
      return '';
    }

    function attachmentCard(attachment) {
      return `<div class="attachment">
        <strong>${esc(attachment.file_name)}</strong>
        ${renderAttachmentPreview(attachment)}
        <div class="tag-row">
          <span class="tag">${esc(attachment.mime_type || 'application/octet-stream')}</span>
          <span class="tag">${esc(formatBytes(attachment.byte_size))}</span>
          ${attachment.pixel_width && attachment.pixel_height ? `<span class="tag">${attachment.pixel_width} x ${attachment.pixel_height}</span>` : ''}
          ${attachment.pdf_page_count ? `<span class="tag">${attachment.pdf_page_count} pages</span>` : ''}
          <span class="tag">${esc(attachment.analysis_status || 'READY')}</span>
          <span class="tag">${attachment.content_available ? 'Preview available' : 'Metadata only'}</span>
        </div>
        ${pdfAnalysisPanel(attachment)}
        <p class="muted">${esc(attachment.analysis_error || (attachment.content_available ? 'Preview is available for review only; no download button is provided.' : 'Physical file was removed after retention.'))}</p>
        ${attachment.content_available ? `<button type="button" onclick="previewAttachment(${attachment.id})">Preview for Review</button>` : ''}
      </div>`;
    }

    function approvalForm(id) {
      return `<div id="approval-${id}">
        <label>Your name</label><input id="name-${id}" autocomplete="name">
        <label>Confirmation method</label><select id="method-${id}">
          <option value="DIGITAL_SIGNATURE">Digital signature</option>
        </select>
        <label>Typed signature / confirmation</label>
        <textarea id="signature-${id}" placeholder="Type your full name and confirmation"></textarea>
        <div class="actions">
          <button onclick="decide(${id},'APPROVED')">Approve Additional Work</button>
          <button class="reject" onclick="decide(${id},'REJECTED')">Reject</button>
        </div></div>`;
    }

    function quotationCard(quotation) {
      if (!quotation) return '';
      return `<section class="card"><h2>Accepted Quotation</h2>
        <p><strong>Total:</strong> ${esc(money(quotation.total_paise))}</p>
        <p><strong>Revision:</strong> ${esc(quotation.revision_no)} | <strong>Status:</strong> ${esc(label(quotation.status))}${quotation.tax_inclusive ? ' | Tax inclusive' : ''}</p>
        ${quotation.lines?.length ? quotation.lines.map(line => `<div class="item">
          <strong>${esc(line.description || '-')}</strong>
          <div>${esc(line.quantity)} ${esc(line.unit || '')} | ${esc(money(line.line_total_paise))}</div>
          ${line.tax_rate ? `<small>Tax ${esc(line.tax_rate)}%</small>` : ''}
        </div>`).join('') : '<p class="muted">No quotation lines available.</p>'}
      </section>`;
    }

    async function load(message = '') {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/job-portal/${encodeURIComponent(token)}`);
        const job = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(job.error || 'Unable to open job');
        currentJob = job;
        app.innerHTML = `${message ? `<div class="message">${esc(message)}</div>` : ''}
          <header><small>Tarangini Job Status</small><h1>${esc(job.job_token)}</h1>
            <div class="muted">${esc(job.customer_name)}</div>
            <div class="summary">
              <div><span>Status</span><strong class="status">${esc(label(job.current_status))}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Priority</span><strong>${esc(label(job.priority))}</strong></div>
              <div><span>Promised delivery</span><strong>${esc(date(job.promised_delivery_at))}</strong></div>
            </div></header>
          <section class="card"><h2>Commitment</h2><p>${esc(job.customer_commitment || '-')}</p></section>
          ${job.final_bill_number ? `<section class="card"><h2>Billing Link</h2>
            <p><strong>Invoice:</strong> ${esc(job.final_bill_number)}</p>
            <p><strong>Payment Status:</strong> ${esc(label(job.financial_status || 'OPEN'))}</p>
          </section>` : ''}
          ${quotationCard(job.quotation)}
          <section class="card"><h2>Services</h2>${job.items.map(item => `<div class="item">
            <strong>${esc(item.service_snapshot)}</strong><div>${esc(item.description)}</div>
            <small>${esc(item.quantity)} ${esc(item.unit)}${item.specifications?.notes ? ` | ${esc(item.specifications.notes)}` : ''}</small>
          </div>`).join('')}</section>
          <section class="card"><h2>Shared Files</h2>${job.attachments.length
            ? job.attachments.map(attachmentCard).join('')
            : '<p class="muted">No customer-visible files yet.</p>'}</section>
          <section class="card">
            <h2>Upload Files for Counter / Owner</h2>
            <p class="muted">Images keep original resolution metadata. PDFs run through the customer PDF Analyzer for page count, page-size profile, and original-file validation.</p>
            <label>Select file</label>
            <input id="portal-upload-file" type="file" accept=".pdf,image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp">
            <p id="portal-upload-selection" class="muted upload-note">Accepted: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP. Original file bytes are stored as uploaded.</p>
            <div id="portal-pdf-analysis" class="muted upload-note"></div>
            <div id="portal-pdf-confirm" class="muted upload-note"></div>
            <label>Purpose</label>
            <select id="portal-upload-purpose">
              <option value="CUSTOMER_UPLOAD">Customer Upload</option>
              <option value="CUSTOMER_APPROVAL_EVIDENCE">Approval Evidence</option>
              <option value="CUSTOMER_REFERENCE">Reference File</option>
            </select>
            <button onclick="uploadAttachment()">Upload File</button>
            <p id="portal-upload-status" class="muted upload-note"></p>
          </section>
          <section class="card"><h2>Additional Work</h2>${job.additions.length ? job.additions.map(addition => `
            <div class="addition ${addition.state === 'AWAITING_CUSTOMER' ? 'awaiting' : ''}">
              <strong>${esc(addition.customer_description)}</strong>
              <div>${esc(addition.quantity)} ${esc(addition.unit)} | ${money(addition.total_paise)}</div>
              <small>${esc(label(addition.state))}</small>
              ${addition.state === 'AWAITING_CUSTOMER' ? approvalForm(addition.id) : ''}
            </div>`).join('') : '<p class="muted">No additional-work requests.</p>'}</section>
          <section class="card"><h2>Progress History</h2>${job.timeline.map(event => `<div class="event">
            <strong>${esc(label(event.to_status))}</strong><div>${esc(event.reason || '')}</div><small>${esc(date(event.occurred_at))}</small>
          </div>`).join('')}</section>
          <div id="preview-modal" class="preview-modal" onclick="closePreview(event)">
            <div class="preview-box" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
              <button type="button" class="reject" onclick="closePreview()">Close Preview</button>
              <h2 id="preview-title" style="margin-top:12px">File Preview</h2>
              <div id="preview-body"></div>
            </div>
          </div>`;
        bindUploadSelection();
      } catch (error) {
        app.innerHTML = `<div class="card message error">${esc(error.message)}</div>`;
      }
    }

    function previewAttachment(id) {
      const modal = document.getElementById('preview-modal');
      const title = document.getElementById('preview-title');
      const body = document.getElementById('preview-body');
      if (!modal || !title || !body) return;
      const attachment = currentJob?.attachments?.find(file => Number(file.id) === Number(id));
      const name = attachment?.file_name || 'File Preview';
      const mime = attachment?.mime_type || '';
      const src = `/api/job-portal/${encodeURIComponent(token)}/attachments/${id}/content`;
      title.textContent = name || 'File Preview';
      if (mime.startsWith('image/')) {
        body.innerHTML = `<img class="attachment-preview" style="max-height:70vh" src="${src}" alt="${esc(name)}">`;
      } else if (mime === 'application/pdf') {
        body.innerHTML = `<iframe class="preview-frame" src="${src}#toolbar=0&navpanes=0"></iframe>`;
      } else {
        body.innerHTML = `<iframe class="preview-frame" src="${src}"></iframe>`;
      }
      modal.classList.add('open');
    }

    function closePreview(event) {
      if (event && event.target?.id !== 'preview-modal') return;
      const modal = document.getElementById('preview-modal');
      const body = document.getElementById('preview-body');
      if (body) body.innerHTML = '';
      if (modal) modal.classList.remove('open');
    }

    function bindUploadSelection() {
      const input = document.getElementById('portal-upload-file');
      const note = document.getElementById('portal-upload-selection');
      const analysisBox = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-analysis');
      const confirmBox = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-confirm');
      if (!input || !note || input.dataset.bound === '1') return;
      input.dataset.bound = '1';
      input.addEventListener('change', async () => {
        const file = input.files?.[0];
        if (!file) {
          note.textContent = 'Accepted: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP. Original file bytes are stored as uploaded.';
          if (analysisBox) analysisBox.innerHTML = '';
          if (confirmBox) confirmBox.innerHTML = '';
          return;
        }
        let detail = `${file.name} | ${file.type || 'application/octet-stream'} | ${formatBytes(file.size)}`;
        if ((file.type || '').startsWith('image/')) {
          try {
            const dimensions = await imageDimensions(file);
            detail += ` | ${dimensions.width} x ${dimensions.height}`;
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        if (file.type === 'application/pdf') {
          detail += ' | PDF analyzer will verify page count and page sizes';
          if (analysisBox) {
            analysisBox.innerHTML = '<span class="tag">Analyzing PDF...</span>';
            const analysis = await analyzeSelectedPortalPdf(file, analysisBox);
            if (confirmBox) {
              confirmBox.innerHTML = renderPortalPdfConfirmationCard(analysis);
              syncPortalPdfCounts();
            }
          }
        } else {
          if (analysisBox) analysisBox.innerHTML = '';
          if (confirmBox) confirmBox.innerHTML = '';
        }
        note.textContent = detail;
      });
    }

    function imageDimensions(file) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        const image = new Image();
        image.onload = () => {
          resolve({ width: image.naturalWidth, height: image.naturalHeight });
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        };
        image.onerror = () => {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          reject(new Error('Unable to inspect image dimensions'));
        };
        image.src = url;
      });
    }

    function fileToBase64(file) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result || '').split(',')[1] || '');
        reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Unable to read selected file'));
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      });
    }

    function renderPortalPdfConfirmationCard(analysis) {
      const totalPages = Number(analysis?.pdf_page_count || 0) || 1;
      return `<div class="card" style="margin-top:8px;padding:14px">
        <h3 style="margin-bottom:8px">Record Print Requirement</h3>
        <label><input id="portal-pdf-print-active" type="checkbox" style="width:auto;margin-right:8px" onchange="togglePortalPdfPrintRequest()">Colour Print Active</label>
        <div class="tag-row" style="margin-top:8px">
          <span class="tag">Analyzed pages ${esc(totalPages)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="actions" style="margin-top:8px">
          <div><label>Confirmed Total Pages</label><input id="portal-pdf-total" type="number" min="1" step="1" value="${esc(totalPages)}" onchange="syncPortalPdfCounts()"></div>
          <div><label>Colour Pages</label><input id="portal-pdf-color" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="0" onchange="syncPortalPdfCounts()" disabled></div>
        </div>
        <div class="actions" style="margin-top:8px">
          <div><label>B/W Pages</label><input id="portal-pdf-bw" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="${esc(totalPages)}" readonly></div>
          <div><label>Confirmation</label><label><input id="portal-pdf-confirmed" type="checkbox" style="width:auto;margin-right:8px">I confirm these page counts</label></div>
        </div>
        <label>Notes for Operator</label>
        <textarea id="portal-pdf-notes" placeholder="Optional note about color pages, cover pages, duplex, or special print instructions"></textarea>
      </div>`;
    }

    async function analyzeSelectedPortalPdf(file, target) {
      try {
        const contentBase64 = await fileToBase64(file);
        const response = await fetch(`/api/job-portal/${encodeURIComponent(token)}/analyze-upload`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            file_name: file.name,
            mime_type: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
            content_base64: contentBase64
          })
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || 'PDF analysis failed');
        const analysis = result.analysis || {};
        const metadata = analysis.metadata || {};
        target.innerHTML = `<div class="tag-row">
          <span class="tag">PDF Analyzer ${esc(analysis.analysis_status || 'READY')}</span>
          ${analysis.pdf_page_count ? `<span class="tag">${analysis.pdf_page_count} pages</span>` : ''}
          ${pageSizeSummary(metadata) ? `<span class="tag">${esc(pageSizeSummary(metadata))}</span>` : ''}
          ${metadata.uniform_page_size ? `<span class="tag">Uniform ${esc(metadata.uniform_page_size)}</span>` : ''}
          ${metadata.has_mixed_page_sizes ? '<span class="tag">Mixed page sizes</span>' : ''}
        </div>
        <p class="muted">${esc(analysis.analysis_error || 'PDF structure looks readable and the original bytes will be stored unchanged.')}</p>`;
        return analysis;
      } catch (error) {
        target.innerHTML = `<p class="muted error">${esc(error.message)}</p>`;
        return null;
      }
    }

    function togglePortalPdfPrintRequest() {
      const enabled = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-print-active')?.checked;
      const colorInput = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-color');
      if (colorInput) colorInput.disabled = !enabled;
      syncPortalPdfCounts();
    }

    function syncPortalPdfCounts() {
      const enabled = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-print-active')?.checked;
      const totalInput = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-total');
      const colorInput = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-color');
      const bwInput = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-bw');
      if (!totalInput || !colorInput || !bwInput) return;
      let total = Math.max(1, Number(totalInput.value || 1));
      let color = Math.max(0, Number(colorInput.value || 0));
      if (!enabled) {
        colorInput.value = '0';
        bwInput.value = String(total);
        return;
      }
      if (color > total) {
        color = total;
        colorInput.value = String(color);
      }
      bwInput.value = String(Math.max(0, total - color));
    }

    function portalPdfPrintRequest() {
      const totalInput = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-total');
      const colorInput = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-color');
      const bwInput = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-bw');
      const printActive = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-print-active');
      const confirmed = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-confirmed');
      const notes = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-notes');
      if (!totalInput || !colorInput || !bwInput || !printActive || !confirmed) return null;
      return {
        colour_print_active: Boolean(printActive.checked),
        customer_confirmed_total_pages: Number(totalInput.value || 0),
        customer_confirmed_color_pages: Number(colorInput.value || 0),
        customer_confirmed_bw_pages: Number(bwInput.value || 0),
        customer_page_confirmation: Boolean(confirmed.checked),
        confirmation_notes: notes?.value?.trim() || ''
      };
    }

    async function uploadAttachment() {
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('portal-upload-file');
      const status = document.getElementById('portal-upload-status');
      const file = fileInput?.files?.[0];
      if (!file) {
        status.textContent = 'Choose a PDF, JPG, PNG, or WebP file first.';
        return;
      }
      status.textContent = 'Uploading...';
      try {
        const contentBase64 = await fileToBase64(file);
        const response = await fetch(`/api/job-portal/${encodeURIComponent(token)}/uploads`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            file_name: file.name,
            mime_type: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
            content_base64: contentBase64,
            purpose: document.getElementById('portal-upload-purpose').value,
            customer_pdf_print_request: portalPdfPrintRequest()
          })
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || 'Upload failed');
        status.textContent = `Uploaded ${result.attachment.file_name}. Size ${formatBytes(result.attachment.byte_size)}.` +
          (result.attachment.pixel_width && result.attachment.pixel_height ? ` Resolution ${result.attachment.pixel_width} x ${result.attachment.pixel_height}.` : '') +
          (result.attachment.pdf_page_count ? ` PDF pages ${result.attachment.pdf_page_count}.` : '') +
          (result.attachment.metadata?.page_size_summary ? ` Page sizes ${result.attachment.metadata.page_size_summary}.` : '');
        fileInput.value = '';
        const selection = document.getElementById('portal-upload-selection');
        const analysisBox = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-analysis');
        const confirmBox = document.getElementById('portal-pdf-confirm');
        if (selection) {
          selection.textContent = 'Accepted: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP. Original file bytes are stored as uploaded.';
        }
        if (analysisBox) analysisBox.innerHTML = '';
        if (confirmBox) confirmBox.innerHTML = '';
        await load('Your file was uploaded successfully.');
      } catch (error) {
        status.textContent = error.message;
      }
    }

    async function decide(id, decision) {
      const approverName = document.getElementById(`name-${id}`).value.trim();
      const confirmation = document.getElementById(`signature-${id}`).value.trim();
      if (!approverName || !confirmation) return alert('Enter your name and confirmation.');
      const response = await fetch(`/api/job-portal/${encodeURIComponent(token)}/additions/${id}/decision`, {
        method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body:JSON.stringify({
          decision, method:document.getElementById(`method-${id}`).value,
          approver_name:approverName, signature_data:confirmation,
          confirmation_text:`${decision} by ${approverName}`
        })
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) return alert(result.error || 'Unable to record decision');
      load(`Your decision was recorded: ${label(decision)}.`);
    }

    load();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

FILE: public\service-worker.js

const CACHE_NAME = 'tarangini-shell-2.4.1-security-1';
const APP_SHELL = [
  '/',
  '/index.html',
  '/style.css?v=2.4.1',
  '/app-2.4.0.js?v=2.4.1-security-1',
  '/vendor/xlsx.full.min.js',
  '/tarangini.png',
  '/manifest.webmanifest'
];

self.addEventListener('install', event => {
  event.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => cache.addAll(APP_SHELL)));
  self.skipWaiting();
});

self.addEventListener('activate', event => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then(keys => Promise.all(
      keys.filter(key => key.startsWith('tarangini-shell-') && key !== CACHE_NAME)
        .map(key => caches.delete(key))
    ))
  );
  self.clients.claim();
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  const request = event.request;
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  if (request.method !== 'GET' || url.origin !== self.location.origin || url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) {
    return;
  }
  if (/\.(?:js|css)$/i.test(url.pathname)) {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(request, { cache: 'no-store' }).then(response => {
        if (response.ok) {
          const copy = response.clone();
          caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => cache.put(request, copy));
        }
        return response;
      }).catch(() => caches.match(request))
    );
    return;
  }
  if (request.mode === 'navigate') {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(request).then(response => {
        const copy = response.clone();
        caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => cache.put('/index.html', copy));
        return response;
      }).catch(() => caches.match('/index.html'))
    );
    return;
  }
  event.respondWith(
    caches.match(request).then(cached => cached || fetch(request).then(response => {
      if (response.ok) {
        const copy = response.clone();
        caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => cache.put(request, copy));
      }
      return response;
    }))
  );
});

# TARANGINI WORKFLOW SUITE
## Merged Billing, Production Workflow And Customer Portal

---

## WINDOWS DESKTOP INSTALLATION (3 COMPUTERS)

Current source version: `1.0.0`

Installer: `dist/Tarangini Workflow Suite Setup 1.0.0.exe`
ZIP package: `dist/Tarangini Workflow Suite-1.0.0-win.zip`

Version 1.0.0 establishes the merged Tarangini Workflow Suite baseline:

- Billing, accounting, POS and stock remain integrated.
- Job intake, production workflow and customer portal remain integrated.
- Backup import/export now carries job workflow, customer portal state and attachment metadata without permanently backing up normal attachment bytes.
- Data-shift tracking is stored for safer recovery and migration reviews.
- Jobs can be first-billed from an accepted estimate and later delivered against the same linked invoice when the amount has not changed.

1. Install the same setup file on all three Windows computers.
2. On exactly one computer, choose **MAIN SYSTEM** on the startup selector.
3. Keep the main computer switched on whenever the billing software is in use.
4. On the other two computers, choose **CLIENT SYSTEM** and click **Find Main System Automatically**.
5. If automatic discovery does not find it, run `ipconfig` on the main computer and manually enter its IPv4 Address, for example `192.168.1.10`.
6. Allow Tarangini Workflow Suite through Windows Firewall if Windows asks.

All three computers use the one database stored on the main computer. Saved changes are written immediately and open clients refresh automatically after another computer changes data.
Recorded storage direction: keep accounting and job orders in one linked business database to avoid sync collisions. Store large customer uploads in active filesystem attachment storage, keep permanent metadata in the database, and only separately archive/back up files the owner marks important.

The installer creates a **Tarangini Workflow Suite** Desktop shortcut and Start Menu shortcut.
The ZIP package is provided as a portable/manual distribution artifact for review, copying and controlled deployment checks.

The selector appears at every desktop startup. It can also be reopened using **Main / Client Setup** in the sidebar or application menu.
Use **Test Connection** on a client computer before saving. Owner2 can sign in with `owner2` / `owner123` until Owner1 assigns a daily PIN; each client must complete one online login to the Main System before offline login is available.

Current network behavior: the Main System app/server must remain running for customer QR intake, status lookup, operator pages and client computers to work. A future recorded upgrade will add an optional always-on background service/boot-start mode so the network portal can remain active even when the desktop window is closed.

---

## INTERNET DEPLOYMENT

Tarangini Workflow Suite can now be exposed for secure remote invoice and workflow access over the internet.

Recommended production settings:

- `TARANGINI_INTERNET_MODE=1`
- `TARANGINI_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://your-domain.example`
- `TARANGINI_HTTPS_PFX` and `TARANGINI_HTTPS_PFX_PASSPHRASE`
  or `TARANGINI_HTTPS_KEY` and `TARANGINI_HTTPS_CERT`
- `TARANGINI_ALLOWED_HOSTS=your-domain.example`
- `TARANGINI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://your-domain.example`
- `TARANGINI_ADMIN_ALLOWED_IPS=` followed by trusted office/static IPs for owner-only administration

Internet mode protections:

- refuses insecure public startup without HTTPS
- generates customer portal and mobile login URLs from the configured public base URL
- rejects unexpected host headers
- supports optional owner/admin IP restrictions for high-risk operations

Online-readiness foundation added in version `1.0.0`:

- deployment and upload limits are now environment-configurable instead of desktop-only hard-coded values
- customer intake supports `X-Idempotency-Key` retry protection for future Android app and website submissions
- `/api/health` and diagnostics now expose the active deployment profile, target concurrency and storage mode
- current default target profile is prepared for `100-200` concurrent customer sessions, but attachment growth planning is still required for public internet scale
- deployment profiles are now available for `lan`, `store`, and `public`
- attachment storage now supports both `inline-db` and `filesystem` modes
- attachment analysis now supports both `sync` and `async` modes, with customer PDF print-confirmation flows forced through synchronous validation when needed
- async attachment analysis uses a persistent queue with startup recovery and owner diagnostics
- normal attachments use a 7-day post-delivery retention policy by default; archived attachments are excluded from auto-delete

Recommended extra settings for future Android app and website rollout:

- `TARANGINI_TARGET_CONCURRENT_CUSTOMERS=200`
- `TARANGINI_REQUEST_BODY_LIMIT_MB=50`
- `TARANGINI_CUSTOMER_UPLOAD_LIMIT_MB=15`
- `TARANGINI_STAFF_UPLOAD_LIMIT_MB=10`
- `TARANGINI_CUSTOMER_PORTAL_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=600`

---

## CUSTOMER QR INTAKE FLOW

Counter staff can now open **Jobs > Customer Intake QR** to generate a public QR code and shareable link for the selected company.

Customer-side flow:

- customer scans the QR code
- customer lands on a cleaner Home page with buttons for Track Order and New Request
- customer can open a dedicated tracking page using Order ID and phone number
- customer selects a service family, which opens its own service-specific request page
- customer selects the exact service before the detailed form opens
- customer enters name, phone, job or device details, requested delivery, and instructions
- customer uploads PDF, JPG, PNG, or WebP files with preview and delete-before-submit controls
- Tarangini keeps original file bytes while the work is active, permanently keeps metadata, verifies PDF page count, and records best-effort PDF colour-page hints

Staff-side flow:

- the request appears in **Jobs > Customer QR Requests**
- counter staff reviews the uploaded details and files
- owner/operator can download active uploaded files for one request as a ZIP bundle while those files are retained
- staff can link the request to an existing customer or create a new customer automatically
- staff converts the request into a normal job order with estimate, service, and promised delivery
- customer uploads are copied into the final job record, remain previewable while retained, and remain as metadata-only history after cleanup
- owner/finance can create a first bill from the accepted estimate before production is complete
- delivery reuses the linked first bill when the final job amount still matches, preventing duplicate invoices

Backup import and export now include QR intake requests and attachment metadata. Normal attachment bytes are not permanently backed up unless the owner archives them separately.

---

## FINANCIAL REPORTS AND BALANCE SHEET

Open **Reports > Financial Reports** for:

- Balance Sheet with automatic balance check
- Profit and Loss
- Trial Balance with account-ledger drill-down
- Day Book
- Cash and Bank balances
- Receivables and Payables
- GST summary
- Sales Register
- Payment Register
- Expenses and Purchases Register

Sales bills, receipts, and payment vouchers post automatically to the accounts.

Use **Reports > Journal Entry** to record purchases, operating expenses, fixed assets, loans, owner capital, depreciation, and accounting adjustments. Every journal must have equal debit and credit totals.

Common entries:

- Expense paid: Debit the expense account, Credit Cash or Bank
- Credit purchase: Debit Purchases, Credit Accounts Payable and select the vendor
- Asset purchased: Debit Fixed Assets, Credit Cash, Bank, or Loans
- Capital introduced: Debit Cash or Bank, Credit Owner Capital

Balance Sheet accuracy depends on entering all business transactions, including purchases, expenses, assets, loans, and capital.

---

## AUTOMATIC SECURITY LOCK

Owners can open **Settings > Auto Lock** to:

- Enable or disable automatic locking
- Choose the inactivity timeout
- Choose how many seconds before locking the warning appears
- Lock the application immediately for testing

The lock applies to all connected computers. Each computer measures its own user activity. The current user's password is required to unlock, and the open billing screen remains preserved behind the lock.

---

## COMPANY SELECTION IN VOUCHERS

Every Sale Bill, Project Printing Invoice, Quotation, Delivery Challan, Proforma Invoice, Receipt, Payment Voucher, and Journal Entry includes a prominent **Voucher Company** selector.

Changing the company:

- Updates the sidebar company context
- Loads that company's parties, items, GST setup, and accounts
- Refreshes the displayed voucher number
- Uses an independent company, voucher-type, and financial-year sequence

Voucher numbers also refresh when the voucher date or journal voucher type changes. Sequence counters are included in backups so restored data continues from the correct number.

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

from reportlab.lib import colors
from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_CENTER, TA_LEFT
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4, landscape
from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle, getSampleStyleSheet
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.platypus import (
    KeepTogether,
    ListFlowable,
    ListItem,
    LongTable,
    PageBreak,
    Paragraph,
    Preformatted,
    SimpleDocTemplate,
    Spacer,
    Table,
    TableStyle,
)


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / "docs" / "COMPLETE_TOOL_UML.md"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "output" / "pdf" / "Tarangini_Complete_Tool_UML_And_Process_Map.pdf"


def clean_inline(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;")
    text = re.sub(r"`([^`]+)`", r"<font name='Courier'>\1</font>", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\*\*([^*]+)\*\*", r"<b>\1</b>", text)
    return text


def wrap_code(text: str, max_len: int = 108) -> str:
    wrapped: list[str] = []
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line = raw.rstrip()
        if not line:
            wrapped.append("")
            continue
        indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))
        prefix = " " * min(indent, 10)
        remaining = line
        while len(remaining) > max_len:
            cut = remaining.rfind(" ", 0, max_len)
            if cut < 35:
                cut = max_len
            wrapped.append(remaining[:cut].rstrip())
            remaining = prefix + "  " + remaining[cut:].lstrip()
        wrapped.append(remaining)
    return "\n".join(wrapped)


def parse_markdown(markdown: str):
    blocks = []
    lines = markdown.splitlines()
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]
        if line.startswith("# "):
            blocks.append(("title", line[2:].strip()))
        elif line.startswith("## "):
            blocks.append(("h2", line[3:].strip()))
        elif line.startswith("### "):
            blocks.append(("h3", line[4:].strip()))
        elif line.startswith("```"):
            fence = line[3:].strip() or "code"
            i += 1
            code_lines = []
            while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith("```"):
                code_lines.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            blocks.append(("code", fence, "\n".join(code_lines)))
        elif line.startswith("|"):
            table_lines = []
            while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("|"):
                table_lines.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            i -= 1
            blocks.append(("table", table_lines))
        elif re.match(r"^\d+\.\s+", line):
            items = []
            while i < len(lines) and re.match(r"^\d+\.\s+", lines[i]):
                items.append(re.sub(r"^\d+\.\s+", "", lines[i]).strip())
                i += 1
            i -= 1
            blocks.append(("ordered_list", items))
        elif line.strip():
            para = [line.strip()]
            while i + 1 < len(lines):
                nxt = lines[i + 1]
                if (
                    not nxt.strip()
                    or nxt.startswith("#")
                    or nxt.startswith("```")
                    or nxt.startswith("|")
                    or re.match(r"^\d+\.\s+", nxt)
                ):
                    break
                para.append(nxt.strip())
                i += 1
            blocks.append(("paragraph", " ".join(para)))
        i += 1
    return blocks


def parse_table(table_lines: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
    rows = []
    for line in table_lines:
        cells = [cell.strip() for cell in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
        if cells and all(re.fullmatch(r":?-{3,}:?", cell or "") for cell in cells):
            continue
        rows.append(cells)
    return rows


def add_header_footer(canvas, doc):
    canvas.saveState()
    width, height = landscape(A4)
    canvas.setFillColor(colors.HexColor("#1f2933"))
    canvas.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 8)
    canvas.drawString(16 * mm, height - 10 * mm, "Tarangini Workflow Suite - Complete UML And Process Map")
    canvas.setFont("Helvetica", 8)
    canvas.drawRightString(width - 16 * mm, 9 * mm, f"Page {doc.page}")
    canvas.setStrokeColor(colors.HexColor("#d9e2ec"))
    canvas.line(16 * mm, height - 12 * mm, width - 16 * mm, height - 12 * mm)
    canvas.line(16 * mm, 13 * mm, width - 16 * mm, 13 * mm)
    canvas.restoreState()


def build_pdf():
    markdown = SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    blocks = parse_markdown(markdown)
    OUTPUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    doc = SimpleDocTemplate(
        str(OUTPUT),
        pagesize=landscape(A4),
        rightMargin=14 * mm,
        leftMargin=14 * mm,
        topMargin=17 * mm,
        bottomMargin=17 * mm,
        title="Tarangini Complete Tool UML And Process Map",
        author="Tarangini Workflow Suite",
    )

    styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
    styles.add(
        ParagraphStyle(
            name="CoverTitle",
            parent=styles["Title"],
            fontName="Helvetica-Bold",
            fontSize=25,
            leading=31,
            alignment=TA_CENTER,
            textColor=colors.HexColor("#102a43"),
            spaceAfter=12,
        )
    )
    styles.add(
        ParagraphStyle(
            name="CoverSubtitle",
            parent=styles["BodyText"],
            fontSize=12,
            leading=18,
            alignment=TA_CENTER,
            textColor=colors.HexColor("#334e68"),
            spaceAfter=16,
        )
    )
    styles.add(
        ParagraphStyle(
            name="SectionHeading",
            parent=styles["Heading2"],
            fontName="Helvetica-Bold",
            fontSize=14,
            leading=18,
            textColor=colors.HexColor("#0b7285"),
            spaceBefore=8,
            spaceAfter=6,
            keepWithNext=True,
        )
    )
    styles.add(
        ParagraphStyle(
            name="SmallHeading",
            parent=styles["Heading3"],
            fontName="Helvetica-Bold",
            fontSize=11,
            leading=14,
            textColor=colors.HexColor("#243b53"),
            spaceBefore=6,
            spaceAfter=4,
        )
    )
    styles.add(
        ParagraphStyle(
            name="BodyCustom",
            parent=styles["BodyText"],
            fontSize=9,
            leading=13,
            textColor=colors.HexColor("#243b53"),
            spaceAfter=5,
        )
    )
    code_style = ParagraphStyle(
        name="Code",
        fontName="Courier",
        fontSize=6.3,
        leading=8,
        textColor=colors.HexColor("#102a43"),
        backColor=colors.HexColor("#f0f4f8"),
        borderColor=colors.HexColor("#bcccdc"),
        borderPadding=6,
        borderWidth=0.4,
        leftIndent=0,
        rightIndent=0,
        spaceBefore=2,
        spaceAfter=7,
    )
    cell_style = ParagraphStyle(
        name="Cell",
        parent=styles["BodyText"],
        fontSize=6.1,
        leading=7.3,
        textColor=colors.HexColor("#243b53"),
    )
    header_cell_style = ParagraphStyle(
        name="HeaderCell",
        parent=cell_style,
        fontName="Helvetica-Bold",
        textColor=colors.white,
        alignment=TA_LEFT,
    )

    story = []
    story.append(Spacer(1, 38 * mm))
    story.append(Paragraph("Tarangini Workflow Suite", styles["CoverTitle"]))
    story.append(Paragraph("Complete Tool UML And Transaction Process Explanation", styles["CoverTitle"]))
    story.append(
        Paragraph(
            "Billing, accounting, inventory, job order workflow, customer portal, security, backup, sync and deployment.",
            styles["CoverSubtitle"],
        )
    )
    story.append(
        Table(
            [[
                Paragraph("<b>Purpose</b>", styles["BodyCustom"]),
                Paragraph(
                    "Department-wise explanation PDF for owner review, operator training, customer portal flow, and end-to-end transaction verification.",
                    styles["BodyCustom"],
                ),
            ]],
            colWidths=[35 * mm, 190 * mm],
            style=[
                ("BACKGROUND", (0, 0), (-1, -1), colors.HexColor("#d9f0f4")),
                ("BOX", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.7, colors.HexColor("#0b7285")),
                ("VALIGN", (0, 0), (-1, -1), "TOP"),
                ("LEFTPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8),
                ("RIGHTPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8),
                ("TOPPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8),
                ("BOTTOMPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8),
            ],
        )
    )
    story.append(PageBreak())

    story.append(Paragraph("How To Read This PDF", styles["SectionHeading"]))
    intro_items = [
        "Sections 1-3 explain the complete application architecture, permissions and database entities.",
        "Sections 4-11 explain customer intake, owner review, operator assignment, production, delivery and job billing.",
        "Sections 12-19 explain billing, accounting, payments, inventory and bank transactions.",
        "Sections 20-26 explain reports, customer portal, file retention, backup, security, sync and installer/update flow.",
        "Section 27 is the transaction checklist: every major action, API, table, accounting effect, stock effect and audit effect.",
    ]
    story.append(
        ListFlowable(
            [ListItem(Paragraph(clean_inline(item), styles["BodyCustom"])) for item in intro_items],
            bulletType="1",
            start="1",
        )
    )
    story.append(PageBreak())

    for block in blocks:
        kind = block[0]
        if kind == "title":
            continue
        if kind == "h2":
            story.append(Paragraph(clean_inline(block[1]), styles["SectionHeading"]))
        elif kind == "h3":
            story.append(Paragraph(clean_inline(block[1]), styles["SmallHeading"]))
        elif kind == "paragraph":
            story.append(Paragraph(clean_inline(block[1]), styles["BodyCustom"]))
        elif kind == "ordered_list":
            story.append(
                ListFlowable(
                    [ListItem(Paragraph(clean_inline(item), styles["BodyCustom"])) for item in block[1]],
                    bulletType="1",
                    start="1",
                )
            )
            story.append(Spacer(1, 4))
        elif kind == "code":
            fence, code = block[1], block[2]
            label = f"UML / {fence} definition"
            story.append(Paragraph(label, styles["SmallHeading"]))
            story.append(Preformatted(wrap_code(code), code_style, maxLineLength=112))
        elif kind == "table":
            rows = parse_table(block[1])
            if not rows:
                continue
            data = []
            for r_index, row in enumerate(rows):
                style = header_cell_style if r_index == 0 else cell_style
                data.append([Paragraph(clean_inline(cell), style) for cell in row])
            col_count = max(len(row) for row in data)
            for row in data:
                while len(row) < col_count:
                    row.append(Paragraph("", cell_style))
            total_width = 267 * mm
            if col_count == 7:
                col_widths = [24 * mm, 36 * mm, 44 * mm, 48 * mm, 48 * mm, 32 * mm, 35 * mm]
            else:
                col_widths = [total_width / col_count] * col_count
            table = LongTable(data, colWidths=col_widths, repeatRows=1)
            table.setStyle(
                TableStyle(
                    [
                        ("BACKGROUND", (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.HexColor("#0b7285")),
                        ("GRID", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.25, colors.HexColor("#bcccdc")),
                        ("VALIGN", (0, 0), (-1, -1), "TOP"),
                        ("LEFTPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 3),
                        ("RIGHTPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 3),
                        ("TOPPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 3),
                        ("BOTTOMPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 3),
                        ("ROWBACKGROUNDS", (0, 1), (-1, -1), [colors.white, colors.HexColor("#f8fbff")]),
                    ]
                )
            )
            story.append(table)
            story.append(Spacer(1, 8))

    doc.build(story, onFirstPage=add_header_footer, onLaterPages=add_header_footer)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    build_pdf()
    print(OUTPUT)

const express = require('express');
const cors = require('cors');
const compression = require('compression');
const rateLimit = require('express-rate-limit');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const http = require('http');
const https = require('https');
const { initDB, initializeDB } = require('./src/db/db');
const APP_VERSION = require('./package.json').version;
const FRONTEND_ASSET = 'app-2.4.0.js';
const {
  REQUEST_BODY_LIMIT_MB,
  AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX,
  CUSTOMER_PORTAL_RATE_LIMIT_MAX,
  deploymentProfile
} = require('./src/config/deployment-profile');
const {
  INTERNET_MODE, PUBLIC_BASE_URL, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, isLoopbackAddress,
  requestIp, requestIsRemote, hostAllowed, publicBaseUrl
} = require('./src/security/runtime-config');
const { startAttachmentAnalysisWorker } = require('./src/services/attachment-processing');
const { startAttachmentRetentionWorker } = require('./src/services/attachment-retention');

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;
const HTTPS_KEY_PATH = String(process.env.TARANGINI_HTTPS_KEY || '').trim();
const HTTPS_CERT_PATH = String(process.env.TARANGINI_HTTPS_CERT || '').trim();
const HTTPS_PFX_PATH = String(process.env.TARANGINI_HTTPS_PFX || '').trim();
const HTTPS_PFX_PASSPHRASE = String(process.env.TARANGINI_HTTPS_PFX_PASSPHRASE || '');
const HTTPS_ENABLED = Boolean(HTTPS_PFX_PATH || (HTTPS_KEY_PATH && HTTPS_CERT_PATH));
const HTTP_REDIRECT_PORT = Number(process.env.TARANGINI_HTTP_REDIRECT_PORT || 0);
const REQUIRE_HTTPS = process.env.TARANGINI_REQUIRE_HTTPS === '1' || INTERNET_MODE;
let revision = Date.now();
const syncClients = new Set();
const allowedOrigins = [...ALLOWED_ORIGINS];

if (INTERNET_MODE && !HTTPS_ENABLED) {
  throw new Error('Tarangini internet mode requires HTTPS certificates or a PFX configuration.');
}
if (INTERNET_MODE && PUBLIC_BASE_URL && !PUBLIC_BASE_URL.startsWith('https://')) {
  throw new Error('Tarangini internet mode requires TARANGINI_PUBLIC_BASE_URL to use https://');
}

function sameOriginRequest(req, origin) {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(origin);
    const expectedProtocol = req.secure ? 'https:' : 'http:';
    return parsed.protocol === expectedProtocol && parsed.host === req.get('host');
  } catch (_) {
    return false;
  }
}

function broadcastChange(pathname, sourceClientId = '') {
  revision += 1;
  const payload = `data: ${JSON.stringify({
    revision,
    changed: pathname || '',
    source_client_id: String(sourceClientId || ''),
    time: new Date().toISOString()
  })}\n\n`;
  for (const client of syncClients) client.write(payload);
}

// Middleware
app.use(compression());
app.disable('x-powered-by');
app.set('trust proxy', process.env.TARANGINI_TRUST_PROXY === '1' ? 1 : false);
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  if (!hostAllowed(req)) {
    const remote = requestIsRemote(req);
    if (!remote && !INTERNET_MODE) return next();
    return res.status(421).json({ error: 'Request host is not allowed for this Tarangini server' });
  }
  next();
});
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  const remoteAddress = requestIp(req);
  if (REQUIRE_HTTPS && !req.secure && !isLoopbackAddress(remoteAddress)) {
    if (req.path.startsWith('/api/')) {
      return res.status(426).json({ error: 'HTTPS is required for remote Tarangini access' });
    }
    return res.status(426).type('text/plain').send('HTTPS is required for remote Tarangini access.');
  }
  next();
});
app.use(cors({
  origin(origin, callback) {
    if (!origin) return callback(null, true);
    if (allowedOrigins.includes(origin)) return callback(null, true);
    callback(null, false);
  },
  credentials: false
}));

app.use('/api', (req, res, next) => {
  if (!['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'].includes(req.method)) return next();
  const hasCookieSession = /(?:^|;\s*)tarangini_session=/.test(String(req.headers.cookie || ''));
  const hasBearer = /^Bearer\s+\S+/i.test(String(req.headers.authorization || ''));
  if (!hasCookieSession || hasBearer) return next();
  const origin = String(req.headers.origin || '').trim();
  if (!origin || sameOriginRequest(req, origin) || allowedOrigins.includes(origin)) return next();
  return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Cross-origin request blocked' });
});
